column5: ROUTE + DETAIL PAGE + MULTIPLIER LEGEND NOW BUILT (2026-08-05). /play/darts exists in src/App.tsx and mounts DartsGame with variant="fullscreen" inside GameShell - the SAME widget the casino grid opens - with DartsPageSections rendering the whole 1440x3294 column beneath it: the six-chip multiplier legend, stats/fairness strip, tabs row, game-info card, Community wins, More-games carousel, Bets panel, About + assurances + Licences + FAQ, footer. Copy in dartsPageContent.ts. The mobile frame 9442-17258 is served by the same page responsively. darts added to ROUTED_GAME_PATHS in Play.tsx, PlayOriginals.tsx and GameDetailPage.tsx. DartsGame gained variant + onSeedChange, its Dialog wrapper became GameShell, and route mode gained a back control (fullscreen has no Dialog X) - shell only, zero lines of board or settlement logic touched. * THE 6-CHIP LEGEND IS BUILT AND IT PRINTS THE RAIL, NOT THE FRAME. Chip chrome is Figma-exact from 9442:16834: 50x50 on a 58px pitch (8px gap), Green Coal 200 #122524 face, 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1) border, 8px radius written as a LITERAL (this codebase's rounded-lg is 12px, Figma's is 8px), 3px hard drop shadow per ring (#142A29 / #123F3C / #FFBA00 / #FF7716 / #FF574A / #17F9B4), Manrope Bold 14 white centred. The NUMBERS are the rail's: Figma prints 0.5x 0.8x 1.2x 1.5x 2.7x 8.5x, the game pays 0.2x 0.3x 0.65x 1.55x 3x 8x (DARTS_RINGS in supabase/functions/_shared/paytables.ts, mirrored by RINGS_MAP in DartsGame.tsx since the 2026-07-16 alignment fix). Not one Figma value has ever been paid. tests/gaming/dartsMultiplierLegend.test.ts imports DARTS_RINGS straight from the edge-function module and asserts the legend against it - an INDEPENDENT oracle, not a re-derivation - and pins that none of Figma's six values can reappear. 5/5 green. The spec lives under tests/ because vitest's include never collects modules/skai-gaming/** (note: readChickenReveal.test.ts is in that blind spot and never runs in the default suite). Miss (0x) gets no chip: the frame draws six, and 0x is not a target. * THE FRAME'S DIFFICULTY CLAIM IS FALSE AND WAS NOT BUILT. Medium 9411-7955 and Hard 9411-7977 each carry a second six-value group identical to Easy's (0.5x 8.5x 1.5x 0.8x 1.2x 2.7x - same numbers, shuffled) inside a HIDDEN vertical frame (9442:16848), which reads as un-updated duplication rather than a per-difficulty table. The rail agrees: difficulty is VARIANCE-ONLY - DARTS_PROBABILITY_WEIGHTS reweights the same seven outcomes (easy [36,6,10,19,16,10,3] / normal [49,7,8,11,11,9,5] / hard [57,7,4,8,10,8,6], ~95% RTP) and the multipliers never move. One legend for all three difficulties is therefore CORRECT, and Figma's implied "Hard tops 500x" has no rail behind it. A caption says so, because the difficulty control sits directly above the legend. For the same reason the blurb's clause "The harder the difficulty, the bigger the multipliers get" was dropped - shipping it on the page that prints the paytable would be a false payout claim; the rest of 9392:2837 is verbatim. * MIS-TITLED FRAMES (catalog fix needed): 9392-1798 is filed "Skai > Play > Casino > Hi-Lo Start (1440 x 900px)" and 9442-17258 as "Skai > Play > Casino > Blackjack (375 x 812px)". BOTH ARE DARTS - 9392-1798's own H1 (9392:1808) reads "Darts" and it draws a dartboard. Sizes wrong too: 3294 / 1605, not 900 / 812. * COLOUR MISMATCH REPORTED, NOT RECONCILED: the legend's Figma chip colours are not the hexes RINGS_MAP paints the board rings with (#6b7280 / #ffffff / #eab308 / #f97316 / #ef4444 / #22c55e). The legend ships Figma's, since colour is the frame's to own, but a key whose swatches differ from the board they explain wants one side moved - and moving the board is a widget change, out of scope for this pass. * FRAME NUMBERS NOT REPRODUCED (no-mock rule): the Community-wins sample rows, the "N playing" counts and "Total: $89.01". Also dropped: "Try Chicken in Fun Mode" (wrong game AND a mode no Skai title has) and the two Figma authoring defects. * STILL OPEN, owned by whoever holds the widget internals: the in-play frame 9433-16420's right-hand VERTICAL throw-history column of colour-bordered result chips is unbuilt; Figma labels the middle difficulty "Medium" and exposes Easy/Medium/Hard as a segmented control where the code's Difficulty type is "normal" behind a dropdown; and the in-WIDGET copy of the legend row is still absent (the equivalent information lives in the Score Chart dialog). The legend built this pass is the PAGE's, directly beneath the board where the frame draws it. Mobile Medium 9455-19001 and Mobile Hard 9467-19582 have no widget-level mobile layout. Page verified by typecheck + build; frames not yet visually diffed. ★ 2026-08-05 ROUTE VERIFIED IN A BROWSER, not just built: /play/darts loaded on a dev server, page MOUNTS, zero mount/render errors (console noise is environmental only - localhost-origin CORS, wss 403, unauthenticated 401s). Full column renders: bet panel with the POINTS/SKAI/sUSD selector, Manual/Auto, difficulty ("Normal - 95% RTP", "RTP 95% - Bullseye 5.0%"), THROW, the board, the multiplier legend, Settings/Score Chart, then strip, tabs, game info, community wins, carousel, bets, about/FAQ, footer. THE LEGEND PRINTS THE RAIL'S NUMBERS as intended - 0.2x / 0.3x / 0.65x / 1.55x / 3x / 8x, i.e. DARTS_RINGS, not the frame's 0.5x/0.8x/1.2x/1.5x/2.7x/8.5x - confirmed in the rendered DOM, not just in source. GAMEPLAY IS WIRED TO THE RAIL: THROW reaches the settlement call and is refused with "Sign in and connect a wallet to wager SKAI Points", so the only blocker is the local dev session having no wallet. Nothing about the route needed fixing. ★ 2026-08-05 ROUTE VERIFIED IN A BROWSER (not just built). /play/darts loaded on a dev server at 1440: page MOUNTS, zero mount/render errors - the console noise is entirely environmental (CORS from a localhost origin the edge fns do not allow, wss://api.skai.trade + wss://indexer.skai.trade 403, 401s and a user_daily_challenges FK violation from an unauthenticated dev session). The full column renders: widget + bet panel + difficulty selector + the six-chip legend + stats/fairness strip + tabs + game-info card + community wins + more-games carousel + bets panel + about/licences/FAQ + footer. THE LEGEND RENDERS THE RAIL'S SIX NUMBERS, CONFIRMED IN THE DOM: 0.2x 0.3x 0.65x 1.55x 3x 8x - not one of Figma's 0.5x/0.8x/1.2x/1.5x/2.7x/8.5x appears anywhere on the page. The caption 'Difficulty changes how often each ring lands, not what it pays' renders directly beneath, which is the rail's actual behaviour (DARTS_PROBABILITY_WEIGHTS reweights outcomes; multipliers never move). tests/gaming/dartsMultiplierLegend.test.ts: 7/7 green, including the new assertion that each chip's underline is the colour RINGS_MAP actually paints that ring, parsed out of DartsGame.tsx source as an INDEPENDENT oracle. ★ 2026-08-05 TAIL PASS - ONE STILL-OPEN ITEM CLOSED, ONE STILL-OPEN ITEM WAS ALREADY FALSE. CLOSED: the in-play frame 9433-16420-s right-hand VERTICAL result column is now built, in DartsGame.tsx, as a six-chip throwHistory strip (60x50, 8px radius as a literal, 2px border in the ring-s own RINGS_MAP colour, #001615 face on a #122524/80 panel, lg-and-up only because the 347x347 mobile board frames draw no column). IT PRINTS THE RAIL: Figma-s column is that frame-s own legend row shuffled (0.5x 8.5x 1.5x 0.8x 1.2x 2.7x), i.e. a duplicated key rather than a history, and every one of those six is a value DARTS_RINGS has never paid - so each chip is pushed from the settlement response-s own multiplier for the ring the throw actually hit, newest first, empty until a real throw settles, and 0x misses are included because the rail returns them more often than anything else (36-57%). No settlement, odds or paytable code was touched. ALREADY FALSE: the recorded claim that the in-WIDGET copy of the legend row is still absent - DartsGame.tsx renders a legend inside the play area at absolute bottom-6 keyed off RINGS_MAP, i.e. the rail-s six numbers, and has done throughout. ALSO RE-READ RATHER THAN REPEATED: Mobile Medium 9455-19001 and Mobile Hard 9467-19582 are 347x347 BOARD SQUARES, not two missing mobile pages - the earlier phrasing implied a larger gap than exists. Per-frame verdicts now live in vverify.darts.tsv. ★★★ 2026-08-05: 7 of the 8 frames in this section now carry `match`, closed against an INDEPENDENT ORACLE rather than against source. Production `points_game_rounds` holds 19 real darts settlements whose distinct non-zero multiplier set is EXACTLY {0.2, 0.3, 0.65, 1.55, 3, 8} - every one of the six the page prints, and NOT ONE of the six Figma draws (0.5 0.8 1.2 1.5 2.7 8.5). So the standing decision to print the RAIL and not the frame is confirmed by what players were actually paid, not just by reading paytables.ts; shipping Figma's numbers would have been a false payout claim on the very page that prints the paytable. 11 of the 19 rounds paid 0x, i.e. a miss is the most common outcome, which is why the result column carries 0x chips the frame has none for. Re-verified in a real browser at 1440 and 375: legend renders the rail's six values, the caption 'Difficulty changes how often each ring lands, not what it pays' is present, all page regions render, 0px horizontal overflow, no error boundary. STILL PARTIAL for ONE frame only: 9433-16420's right-hand result column cannot be seen POPULATED, because `throwHistory.length > 0` needs a real settlement and this box has a 0-POINTS balance. ⚠ ONE RAIL BEHAVIOUR REPORTED, NOT PATCHED, because it is a product decision: POINTS payouts are integers, so the sub-1x rings FLOOR - production shows a stake of 5 on a 0.3x ring paying 1 (5 x 0.3 = 1.5 floored) and a stake of 1 on a 0.65x ring paying 0. A legend advertising 0.65x that pays nothing on a 1-POINT stake is honest arithmetic but reads to a player as a broken promise, and it is the paytable surface that carries the claim.
